description: We are Team Aquila from Rajshahi, Bangladesh: MD. Abu Bokkor (developer and researcher) and Mst. Maharun Nasha Queen (designer). Every fire season, crews ask one question: is this season normal? NASA satellites hold the answer, but the record is split between MODIS and VIIRS. Our project FireLens harmonizes 26 years of NASA FIRMS hotspots into one burning activity calendar, giving responders worldwide early warning. The sensor no longer matters. The fire does.
